The cast, animated

All ten are cut from the approved hero art and animated in code (no redrawn characters). Each one breathes, blinks and does one signature move. Tap any of them to make them hop and laugh. The rest diff is the mean difference between the layers at rest and the hero image, out of 255 (target under 2). With reduced motion they hold still and a tap only switches on the laughing face.
